summary: Observability can create the appearance of control while adding expense, sensitive telemetry and correlated automated judgments.

points.text: Traces show what the instrumentation captured, not necessarily what caused a real-world outcome; missing environment state can make a complete-looking record misleading.
LLM judges can share blind spots with the generator, so evaluator diversity and human sampling matter more than evaluator count.
Logging prompts, retrieved data and tool output can expose personal data, secrets or licensed material; minimization and access control are part of trust, not optional plumbing.
